desc: Parse input and partition foods into three vitamin-specific lists.
Build a maximum vitamin-intake DP for each group under every calorie limit, ensuring each food is used at most once.
Implement target feasibility by finding the minimum calorie budget needed to reach the target for each vitamin and checking whether their sum is at most X.
Binary-search the answer from 0 through the minimum total available intake among the three vitamins.
Output the maximum feasible target, including 0 when any vitamin is unavailable.
